Aqua Security has published research detailing GhostMap, a stealth and concealment component identified in IronWorm and Atomic Arch malware samples.

The component was analyzed within the executable included in the compromised weavedb-sdk package.

GhostMap functions by hiding selected processes, files, and network connections from standard listing tools without actually removing them from system memory or storage.
